title: 婦科與生殖醫學
intro: 本科程序庫涵蓋異常子宮出血、子宮肌瘤與子宮內膜異位、骨盆腔感染與卵巢扭轉等急症、異位妊娠與早期流產、子宮頸抹片與 HPV 篩檢、陰道鏡與錐狀切除、子宮內視鏡與腹腔鏡手術、子宮切除、婦癌分期與多專科會議、尿失禁與骨盆器官脫垂、更年期、避孕、不孕症評估與人工生殖、多囊性卵巢症候群，以及術後照護與交班。
introEn: This library covers abnormal uterine bleeding, fibroids and endometriosis, pelvic infection and ovarian torsion emergencies, ectopic pregnancy and early pregnancy loss, cervical screening and HPV, colposcopy and LLETZ, hysteroscopic and laparoscopic surgery, hysterectomy, gynaecological cancer staging and MDT, incontinence and prolapse, menopause, contraception, infertility assessment and assisted reproduction, PCOS, and postoperative care and handover.

procedures.title: 異常子宮出血：PALM-COEIN 分類與結構化評估
procedures.titleEn: Abnormal uterine bleeding: PALM-COEIN classification and structured assessment
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：42 歲女性，月經量多、週期不規則六個月，門診由婦科主治、住院醫師與超音波師共同評估。本單元教病史的結構、PALM-COEIN 的分類邏輯與檢查選擇，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 42-year-old with six months of heavy, irregular periods assessed in clinic by the gynaecology attending, resident and sonographer. Teaches structured history, the PALM-COEIN logic and investigation choices; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 病史
stages.evidence: 住院醫師只記錄「月經量多」就想開超音波。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident writes heavy periods and reaches for the scan request.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 先開超音波找出結構病因
choices.en: Scan first to find a structural cause

choices.zh: 結構化出血病史
choices.en: A structured bleeding history

choices.zh: 直接轉子宮鏡檢查內膜
choices.en: Refer straight for hysteroscopy

stages.reason: 出血的型態決定分類方向；經間與性交後出血指向結構或子宮頸病因。
stages.reasonEn: The pattern of bleeding points the classification; intermenstrual and postcoital bleeding suggest structural or cervical causes.
stages.pitfall: 若病史單薄：性交後出血的子宮頸癌被當月經過多。
stages.pitfallEn: A thin history labels postcoital bleeding from cervical cancer as heavy periods.

stages.title: 出血型態判讀
stages.evidence: 週期 21 至 45 天不定、量多、無經間出血。
stages.evidenceEn: Cycles of 21 to 45 days, heavy, no intermenstrual bleeding.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 規則週期的月經過多型態
choices.en: A pattern of heavy bleeding with regular cycles

choices.zh: 不規則加量多：排卵障礙
choices.en: Irregular and heavy: ovulatory dysfunction

choices.zh: 一定是內膜息肉造成的出血
choices.en: Bleeding that must be from a polyp

stages.reason: 不規則週期指向排卵障礙（COEIN 的 O）；規則週期量多更常見結構或止血原因。
stages.reasonEn: Irregular cycles point to ovulatory dysfunction (the O of COEIN); regular heavy cycles favour structural or haemostatic causes.
stages.pitfall: 若誤判：治療針對錯誤的機轉。
stages.pitfallEn: Misread, treatment targets the wrong mechanism.

stages.title: 理學檢查
stages.evidence: 她拒絕內診，說「超音波看得到就好」。
stages.evidenceEn: She declines a pelvic examination, saying the scan will show everything.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 跳過內診，以超音波完全代替
choices.en: Skip the examination; let the scan replace it

choices.zh: 說明鴨嘴檢查的必要並取同意
choices.en: Explain why a speculum exam matters; consent

choices.zh: 堅持檢查，否則不開超音波單
choices.en: Insist, or refuse to order the scan

stages.reason: 子宮頸是出血來源中超音波的盲點；抹片是否過期也在此時確認。
stages.reasonEn: The cervix is ultrasound's blind spot among bleeding sources; screening status is checked at the same time.
stages.pitfall: 若不看子宮頸：子宮頸癌被當作月經問題。
stages.pitfallEn: Cervix unseen, a cervical cancer is treated as a period problem.

stages.title: 基本檢驗
stages.evidence: 住院醫師開了全套荷爾蒙檢查。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident orders a full hormone panel.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 全血球必要，凝血視病史
choices.en: Blood count essential; clotting by history

choices.zh: 全套荷爾蒙都要檢查
choices.en: Check every hormone level

choices.zh: 已有症狀，不需任何檢驗
choices.en: Symptoms are clear; no tests needed

stages.reason: 缺鐵性貧血是最常見的後果；常規荷爾蒙檢查不改變處置。
stages.reasonEn: Iron deficiency is the commonest consequence; routine hormone testing does not change management.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略血球：血紅素 7 的病人在門診暈倒。
stages.pitfallEn: Blood count skipped, she faints in clinic with a haemoglobin of 7.

stages.title: 超音波
stages.evidence: 經陰道超音波：子宮內膜 14 mm 不均勻、兩顆壁內肌瘤。
stages.evidenceEn: Transvaginal scan: endometrium 14 mm and heterogeneous, two intramural fibroids.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 兩顆肌瘤已足以解釋出血
choices.en: The two fibroids explain everything

choices.zh: 肌瘤與可疑內膜並存
choices.en: Fibroids plus a suspicious endometrium

choices.zh: 內膜厚度正常範圍，觀察
choices.en: Endometrium within normal range; observe

stages.reason: PALM 類別可同時存在；肌瘤不能解釋不均勻增厚的內膜。
stages.reasonEn: PALM categories coexist; fibroids do not explain a heterogeneous thickened endometrium.
stages.pitfall: 若只看肌瘤：內膜增生伴非典型被漏掉。
stages.pitfallEn: Fixed on fibroids, atypical hyperplasia is missed.

stages.title: 分類
stages.evidence: 整合：不規則週期、肌瘤、可疑內膜、BMI 偏高、無用藥。
stages.evidenceEn: Integrating: irregular cycles, fibroids, suspicious endometrium, raised BMI, no medicines.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 單一原因：肌瘤可解釋全部
choices.en: A single cause: fibroids explain all

choices.zh: 多因：AUB-L 加 AUB-O
choices.en: Multifactorial: AUB-L plus probable AUB-O

choices.zh: AUB-C：凝血障礙為主要原因
choices.en: AUB-C: a coagulopathy is the main cause

stages.reason: PALM-COEIN 允許多重分類；結構與功能原因常並存。
stages.reasonEn: PALM-COEIN permits several labels; structural and functional causes commonly coexist.
stages.pitfall: 若只標一類：治療不完整。
stages.pitfallEn: One label, incomplete treatment.

stages.title: 取樣
stages.evidence: 主治問誰需要子宮內膜取樣。
stages.evidenceEn: The attending asks who needs endometrial sampling.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 所有月經過多者都要取樣
choices.en: Sample everyone with heavy periods

choices.zh: 有內膜癌風險因子者
choices.en: Those with endometrial cancer risk factors

choices.zh: 只有停經後出血者才需要
choices.en: Only women with postmenopausal bleeding

stages.reason: 取樣的目的是排除增生與癌；風險因子決定門檻。
stages.reasonEn: Sampling excludes hyperplasia and cancer; risk factors set the threshold.
stages.pitfall: 若全部取樣：資源浪費；若都不取：癌被漏。
stages.pitfallEn: Sampling everyone wastes resources; sampling nobody misses cancer.

stages.title: 取樣失敗
stages.evidence: 門診取樣因子宮頸狹窄失敗。
stages.evidenceEn: Outpatient sampling fails because of cervical stenosis.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 取樣失敗就放棄，改觀察
choices.en: Abandon sampling and observe

choices.zh: 安排子宮鏡導引下切片
choices.en: Arrange hysteroscopy with directed biopsy

choices.zh: 同日重複盲目取樣三次
choices.en: Repeat blind sampling three times today

stages.reason: 子宮鏡直視下切片是取樣失敗或局部病變時的下一步。
stages.reasonEn: Hysteroscopic directed biopsy is the next step after failed sampling or with focal lesions.
stages.pitfall: 若放棄：可疑內膜未被診斷。
stages.pitfallEn: Abandoned, the suspicious endometrium goes undiagnosed.

stages.title: 子宮鏡的角色
stages.evidence: 超音波另一位病人：子宮內膜局部息肉樣病變。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient's scan: a focal polypoid lesion in the cavity.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 先用藥物治療三個月再看
choices.en: Medical treatment for three months first

choices.zh: 子宮鏡診斷並同時切除
choices.en: Hysteroscopy to diagnose and remove

choices.zh: 直接安排子宮切除術
choices.en: Proceed straight to hysterectomy

stages.reason: 局部病變（息肉、黏膜下肌瘤）是子宮鏡的明確適應症；見即治省一次程序。
stages.reasonEn: Focal lesions (polyps, submucous fibroids) are clear indications for hysteroscopy; see-and-treat saves a procedure.
stages.pitfall: 若藥物：息肉持續出血。
stages.pitfallEn: On medication the polyp keeps bleeding.

stages.title: 計畫與交班
stages.evidence: 切片結果需兩週；她擔心是癌。
stages.evidenceEn: Biopsy results take two weeks; she fears cancer.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 說明時程並先治貧血
choices.en: Explain the timeline and treat the anaemia now

choices.zh: 等切片結果出來再一起處理
choices.en: Wait for the biopsy, then deal with everything

choices.zh: 告訴她不可能是癌症，別擔心
choices.en: Tell her it cannot be cancer; do not worry

stages.reason: 等待期是焦慮與貧血惡化的時間；結果必須有人負責追蹤。
stages.reasonEn: The waiting period is when anxiety and anaemia worsen; a named person must own the result.
stages.pitfall: 若無人追蹤：非典型增生的報告躺在系統裡三個月。
stages.pitfallEn: Unowned, an atypical hyperplasia report sits in the system for three months.

procedures.title: 月經過多的治療階梯：從左炔諾孕酮子宮內系統到手術
procedures.titleEn: The heavy menstrual bleeding ladder: from the levonorgestrel intrauterine system to surgery
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：38 歲女性，月經過多、缺鐵性貧血，超音波正常、取樣良性。婦科主治、住院醫師與門診護理師共同諮詢。本單元教治療選擇的原則與順序、禁忌與升級時機，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 38-year-old with heavy periods and iron deficiency, normal scan and benign sampling, counselled by the attending, resident and clinic nurse. Teaches treatment principles and order, contraindications and when to escalate, without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 目標
stages.evidence: 住院醫師直接說「放避孕器」；她皺眉說還想生一個。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident says to fit a coil; she frowns and says she wants another child.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 先問生育計畫與避孕需求
choices.en: Ask about fertility plans and contraception first

choices.zh: 堅持放避孕器，效果最好
choices.en: Insist on the coil; it works best

choices.zh: 直接開立止血藥物先試試
choices.en: Just prescribe a haemostatic to try first

stages.reason: 治療選擇被生育意願、避孕需求與偏好決定；沒有問就不會知道。
stages.reasonEn: Choice is shaped by fertility wishes, contraceptive need and preference; unasked, unknown.
stages.pitfall: 若不問：她放了不想要的裝置後自行取出。
stages.pitfallEn: Unasked, she has a device fitted she never wanted and removes it herself.

stages.title: 第一線
stages.evidence: 另一位病人不計畫懷孕；主治問第一線。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient has no pregnancy plans; the attending asks for first line.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 複方口服避孕藥為第一線
choices.en: The combined pill as first line

choices.zh: 子宮切除一次解決
choices.en: Hysterectomy to settle it

choices.zh: 左炔諾孕酮子宮內系統
choices.en: The levonorgestrel intrauterine system

stages.reason: LNG-IUS 減少失血最多、可逆且避孕；初期點狀出血是最常見的放棄原因。
stages.reasonEn: The LNG-IUS gives the greatest reduction in loss, is reversible and contraceptive; early spotting is the commonest reason for removal.
stages.pitfall: 若未預告出血：她三個月內要求取出。
stages.pitfallEn: Unwarned, she asks for removal within three months.

stages.title: 非荷爾蒙
stages.evidence: 她想懷孕，拒絕所有荷爾蒙。
stages.evidenceEn: She wants to conceive and declines all hormones.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 想懷孕就沒有任何藥物選項
choices.en: Wanting pregnancy leaves no drug options

choices.zh: 經期用抗纖溶劑或 NSAID
choices.en: Antifibrinolytic or NSAID during menses

choices.zh: 長期口服類固醇控制出血量
choices.en: Long-term oral steroids to reduce the bleeding

stages.reason: 兩者只在月經期間使用，不影響受孕；NSAID 同時緩解經痛。
stages.reasonEn: Both are taken only during bleeding and do not impair conception; NSAIDs also relieve dysmenorrhoea.
stages.pitfall: 若沒提：她以為只能忍。
stages.pitfallEn: Unoffered, she assumes she must simply endure.

stages.title: 其他荷爾蒙
stages.evidence: LNG-IUS 排除後；她問還有什麼。
stages.evidenceEn: With the IUS excluded she asks what else.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 複方避孕或週期性黃體素
choices.en: Combined contraception or cyclical progestogen

choices.zh: 只剩子宮切除手術一途
choices.en: Hysterectomy is the only option left

choices.zh: 單方雌激素調節週期與量
choices.en: Oestrogen alone to regulate cycle and flow

stages.reason: 複方避孕藥調節週期與減量；黃體素需足夠天數才有效。
stages.reasonEn: Combined contraception regulates and lightens; progestogen needs enough days per cycle to work.
stages.pitfall: 若雌激素單方：內膜增生。
stages.pitfallEn: Unopposed oestrogen breeds hyperplasia.

stages.title: 禁忌
stages.evidence: 她有先兆偏頭痛且吸菸。
stages.evidenceEn: She has migraine with aura and smokes.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 複方荷爾蒙仍可小心使用
choices.en: Combined hormones are still fine with care

choices.zh: 先兆偏頭痛禁用複方荷爾蒙
choices.en: Aura contraindicates combined hormones

choices.zh: 偏頭痛與荷爾蒙用藥選擇無關
choices.en: Migraine has no bearing on hormone choice

stages.reason: 雌激素在先兆偏頭痛者增加缺血性中風；處方前的禁忌篩檢是安全核心。
stages.reasonEn: Oestrogen raises ischaemic stroke in migraine with aura; screening for contraindications is the safety core of prescribing.
stages.pitfall: 若處方：中風。
stages.pitfallEn: Prescribed anyway, she has a stroke.

stages.title: 貧血
stages.evidence: 血紅素偏低、鐵蛋白低；住院醫師只處理月經。
stages.evidenceEn: Low haemoglobin and ferritin; the resident addresses only the bleeding.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 同時補鐵並追蹤血球
choices.en: Replace iron at the same time and recheck the count

choices.zh: 月經控制後自己會好
choices.en: It will recover once bleeding settles

choices.zh: 立即輸血
choices.en: Transfuse now

stages.reason: 貧血造成疲倦與認知影響；補鐵與止血並行。
stages.reasonEn: Anaemia causes fatigue and cognitive effects; iron and bleeding control run together.
stages.pitfall: 若不補鐵：六個月後仍疲倦。
stages.pitfallEn: Iron ignored, she is still exhausted six months on.

stages.title: 升級
stages.evidence: 藥物治療一年無效；家庭已完成。
stages.evidenceEn: A year of medical treatment has failed; her family is complete.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 繼續同樣藥物再多試一年
choices.en: Continue the same drugs for another year

choices.zh: 討論內膜消融與子宮切除
choices.en: Discuss ablation versus hysterectomy

choices.zh: 不需討論，直接安排子宮切除
choices.en: No discussion; book a hysterectomy

stages.reason: 手術選擇在藥物失敗且家庭完成後；消融保留子宮但需持續避孕。
stages.reasonEn: Surgical options follow failed medical treatment once the family is complete; ablation keeps the uterus but needs ongoing contraception.
stages.pitfall: 若直接切除：她不知道有較小的選項。
stages.pitfallEn: Straight to hysterectomy, she never learns of the lesser option.

stages.title: 消融前
stages.evidence: 她選消融；住院醫師準備排程。
stages.evidenceEn: She chooses ablation; the resident books it.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 確認取樣良性並已完成生育
choices.en: Confirm benign sampling and completed family

choices.zh: 她已決定，就直接排程手術
choices.en: She has chosen, so just book it

choices.zh: 消融前不需要再做內膜取樣
choices.en: No endometrial sampling needed beforehand

stages.reason: 消融後懷孕風險高；未取樣的內膜可能藏有癌。
stages.reasonEn: Pregnancy after ablation is high risk; an unsampled endometrium may hide cancer.
stages.pitfall: 若未避孕：消融後懷孕合併胎盤異常。
stages.pitfallEn: Without contraception she conceives with abnormal placentation.

stages.title: 子宮切除的諮詢
stages.evidence: 另一位病人選子宮切除；問要不要同時切卵巢。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient chooses hysterectomy and asks about removing the ovaries.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 子宮切除時一律切除卵巢
choices.en: Always remove the ovaries at hysterectomy

choices.zh: 良性疾病不常規切卵巢
choices.en: Ovaries are not routinely removed for benign disease

choices.zh: 由醫師決定，不需討論
choices.en: The surgeon decides; no discussion

stages.reason: 停經前切除卵巢增加心血管與骨質風險；路徑以陰道或腹腔鏡優先。
stages.reasonEn: Premenopausal oophorectomy raises cardiovascular and bone risk; vaginal or laparoscopic routes are preferred.
stages.pitfall: 若常規切除：提早停經。
stages.pitfallEn: Removed routinely, she enters an early menopause.

stages.title: 追蹤與交班
stages.evidence: 她開始 LNG-IUS 與補鐵。
stages.evidenceEn: She starts the IUS and iron.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 已開始治療，不需要安排追蹤
choices.en: Treatment has started; no follow-up needed

choices.zh: 數月內評估並記錄升級條件
choices.en: Review within months; record escalation criteria

choices.zh: 一年後回診再看治療效果
choices.en: Review the treatment effect in a year

stages.reason: 早期追蹤抓到裝置脫出與持續貧血；升級條件讓下一位醫師能接手。
stages.reasonEn: Early review catches expulsion and persistent anaemia; written escalation criteria let the next doctor take over.
stages.pitfall: 若無追蹤：脫出的裝置與持續出血。
stages.pitfallEn: Unfollowed, an expelled device and ongoing bleeding.

procedures.title: 子宮肌瘤：FIGO 分型、藥物、栓塞、肌瘤切除與子宮切除的選擇
procedures.titleEn: Uterine fibroids: FIGO classification, medical therapy, embolisation, myomectomy and hysterectomy
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：36 歲女性，想懷孕，月經過多與壓迫症狀，超音波多顆肌瘤。婦科主治、生殖醫學、介入放射與住院醫師共同決策。本單元教分型、選項比較、手術安全與併發症辨識，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 36-year-old wishing to conceive, with heavy bleeding and pressure symptoms from multiple fibroids. The gynaecology attending, fertility specialist, interventional radiologist and resident decide together. Teaches classification, comparing options, surgical safety and complication recognition without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stages.title: 目標
stages.evidence: 住院醫師建議子宮切除「一次解決」。
stages.evidenceEn: The resident proposes hysterectomy to solve it once and for all.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 同意子宮切除，一次徹底解決
choices.en: Agree to hysterectomy to settle it for good

choices.zh: 先釐清生育意願與主要症狀
choices.en: Clarify fertility wishes and main symptom first

choices.zh: 肌瘤無惡性風險，不需治療
choices.en: Fibroids are benign; no treatment needed

stages.reason: 肌瘤治療是症狀導向；生育意願排除子宮切除與部分其他選項。
stages.reasonEn: Fibroid treatment is symptom-driven; fertility wishes exclude hysterectomy and some other options.
stages.pitfall: 若切除：她永遠失去生育能力。
stages.pitfallEn: Removed, she loses fertility forever.

stages.title: 分型
stages.evidence: 超音波：一顆 3 公分黏膜下突入腔內超過一半、兩顆壁內、一顆漿膜下帶蒂。
stages.evidenceEn: Scan: a 3 cm submucosal fibroid more than half in the cavity, two intramural, one pedunculated subserosal.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 三種位置的肌瘤處理方式都一樣
choices.en: Fibroids in all three sites are treated alike

choices.zh: FIGO 0–1 型適合子宮鏡
choices.en: FIGO type 0-1 suits hysteroscopy

choices.zh: 帶蒂漿膜下的肌瘤最危險，先切
choices.en: The pedunculated one is most dangerous; remove it first

stages.reason: FIGO 分型（0 至 8）把位置轉成手術路徑；黏膜下肌瘤是出血與不孕的主因。
stages.reasonEn: FIGO types 0 to 8 translate location into surgical route; submucosal fibroids drive bleeding and infertility.
stages.pitfall: 若路徑錯誤：腹腔鏡找不到腔內肌瘤。
stages.pitfallEn: Wrong route, the laparoscope cannot reach the intracavitary fibroid.

stages.title: 惡性警訊
stages.evidence: 另一位 52 歲停經後女性：肌瘤六個月內快速長大、疼痛。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient, 52 and postmenopausal: a fibroid growing rapidly over six months with pain.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 停經後肌瘤生長屬正常現象
choices.en: Postmenopausal fibroid growth is normal

choices.zh: 肉瘤警訊：MRI 與專科評估
choices.en: Sarcoma red flag: MRI and specialist review

choices.zh: 先用 GnRH 藥物縮小再觀察
choices.en: Shrink it with a GnRH analogue and observe

stages.reason: 肉瘤罕見但無可靠術前診斷；警訊改變手術方式。
stages.reasonEn: Sarcoma is rare and lacks a reliable preoperative test; red flags change the operation.
stages.pitfall: 若碎瘤：腫瘤散布腹腔。
stages.pitfallEn: Morcellated, the tumour is scattered through the abdomen.

stages.title: 藥物選項
stages.evidence: 她想先試藥；主治問原則。
stages.evidenceEn: She wants to try medication first; the attending asks for principles.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 藥物治療可以永久消除肌瘤
choices.en: Drug treatment can permanently cure fibroids

choices.zh: 藥物控制出血或術前縮小
choices.en: Drugs control bleeding or shrink before surgery

choices.zh: 肌瘤沒有藥物治療選項
choices.en: There are no drug options for fibroids

stages.reason: LNG-IUS 與抗纖溶劑控制出血；GnRH 類似物可術前橋接，口服拮抗劑加回補可較長期使用。
stages.reasonEn: The IUS and antifibrinolytics control bleeding; GnRH analogues bridge to surgery, and oral antagonists with add-back allow longer-term use.
stages.pitfall: 若長期 GnRH 不回補：骨質流失。
stages.pitfallEn: Prolonged GnRH without add-back loses bone.

stages.title: 栓塞
stages.evidence: 介入放射提議子宮動脈栓塞；她問對懷孕的影響。
stages.evidenceEn: Interventional radiology offers embolisation; she asks about pregnancy.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 栓塞對日後懷孕完全沒有影響
choices.en: Embolisation has no effect on later pregnancy

choices.zh: 影響不確定，想懷孕多選切除
choices.en: Uncertain effect; myomectomy if pregnancy wanted

choices.zh: 栓塞後就絕對不能再懷孕
choices.en: Pregnancy is impossible after embolisation

stages.reason: 栓塞緩解症狀且保留子宮，但有卵巢功能與胎盤異常的疑慮。
stages.reasonEn: Embolisation relieves symptoms and keeps the uterus, but raises concerns about ovarian function and placentation.
stages.pitfall: 若誤導：她在不知情下承擔風險。
stages.pitfallEn: Misinformed, she bears a risk she never agreed to.

stages.title: 術前準備
stages.evidence: 決定腹腔鏡肌瘤切除；麻醉科問備血。
stages.evidenceEn: Laparoscopic myomectomy decided; the anaesthetist asks about blood.
stages.question: 下一步最合理的是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable next step?

choices.zh: 腹腔鏡肌瘤切除很少出血，不必備血
choices.en: Laparoscopic myomectomy rarely bleeds; no blood needed

choices.zh: 矯正貧血、備血並完整同意
choices.en: Correct anaemia, have blood, full consent

choices.zh: 同意書不必提轉開腹或輸血
choices.en: Consent need not mention conversion or transfusion

stages.reason: 肌瘤切除可能大量出血；最壞情況必須寫在同意書上。
stages.reasonEn: Myomectomy can bleed heavily; the worst case belongs on the consent form.
stages.pitfall: 若未提子宮切除：術中必要時無法執行。
stages.pitfallEn: Hysterectomy unmentioned, it cannot be done when needed.

stages.title: 術中出血控制
stages.evidence: 切開肌瘤床後大量滲血。
stages.evidenceEn: The fibroid bed bleeds briskly after incision.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 加快手術速度盡快縫合
choices.en: Speed up and close as quickly as possible

choices.zh: 血管收縮劑與分層縫合
choices.en: Vasoconstrictor infiltration and layered bed closure

choices.zh: 出血太多，立即放棄手術
choices.en: Too much bleeding; abandon the operation now

stages.reason: 肌瘤床的分層縫合是止血與日後子宮強度的關鍵。
stages.reasonEn: Layered closure of the bed secures haemostasis and future uterine strength.
stages.pitfall: 若縫合不佳：懷孕時子宮破裂。
stages.pitfallEn: Poorly closed, the uterus ruptures in pregnancy.

stages.title: 子宮鏡切除
stages.evidence: 黏膜下肌瘤由子宮鏡切除；護理師報告灌流液差額上升。
stages.evidenceEn: The submucosal fibroid is resected hysteroscopically; the nurse reports the fluid deficit rising.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 差額上升仍繼續到切完
choices.en: Keep going until it is all removed

choices.zh: 達上限即停並查電解質
choices.en: Stop at the limit and check electrolytes

choices.zh: 灌流液差額與安全無關
choices.en: The fluid deficit is irrelevant to safety

stages.reason: 灌流液吸收造成低鈉與肺水腫；分次手術比完成手術更安全。
stages.reasonEn: Absorbed distension fluid causes hyponatraemia and pulmonary oedema; staging is safer than finishing.
stages.pitfall: 若繼續：術後抽搐。
stages.pitfallEn: Continued, she seizes postoperatively.

stages.title: 碎瘤
stages.evidence: 另一位病人腹腔鏡子宮切除需取出大子宮。
stages.evidenceEn: Another patient's laparoscopic hysterectomy needs a large uterus removed.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 直接在腹腔內碎瘤取出
choices.en: Open power morcellation in the abdomen

choices.zh: 說明風險，考慮袋內碎瘤
choices.en: Explain the risk; consider contained morcellation

choices.zh: 碎瘤風險很低，不必告知
choices.en: The risk is tiny; no need to mention it

stages.reason: 未密封碎瘤可散布未診斷的肉瘤；告知是同意的必要內容。
stages.reasonEn: Uncontained morcellation can spread an undiagnosed sarcoma; disclosure is part of consent.
stages.pitfall: 若未告知：日後肉瘤擴散成為訴訟。
stages.pitfallEn: Undisclosed, a disseminated sarcoma becomes litigation.

stages.title: 術後與交班
stages.evidence: 肌瘤切除後第 1 天：心跳 110、腹脹。
stages.evidenceEn: Day 1 after myomectomy: heart rate 110, distension.
stages.question: 此時最需警覺的是？
stages.questionEn: What needs the most vigilance now?

choices.zh: 術後心跳快屬正常反應
choices.en: A fast pulse after surgery is normal

choices.zh: 排除出血並交班生產建議
choices.en: Exclude bleeding; hand over birth advice

choices.zh: 腹脹常見，可以直接出院
choices.en: Bloating is common; discharge her

stages.reason: 術後心搏過速是出血的最早徵象；進入子宮腔的切除改變未來生產建議。
stages.reasonEn: Postoperative tachycardia is the earliest sign of bleeding; a cavity-breaching myomectomy changes future birth advice.
stages.pitfall: 若忽略：第 2 天休克。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignored, she is shocked on day 2.

procedures.title: 子宮內膜異位與慢性骨盆痛：診斷、荷爾蒙治療原則與手術時機
procedures.titleEn: Endometriosis and chronic pelvic pain: diagnosis, hormonal treatment principles and timing of surgery
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：29 歲女性，嚴重經痛、深部性交痛與排便痛三年，多次被告知「正常」。婦科主治、內膜異位專科護理師、疼痛科與腸胃外科參與。本單元教症狀辨識、影像限制、治療原則與多專科，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 29-year-old with three years of severe dysmenorrhoea, deep dyspareunia and dyschezia, repeatedly told she is normal. The gynaecology attending, endometriosis nurse specialist, pain team and colorectal surgeon take part. Teaches symptom recognition, imaging limits, treatment principles and multidisciplinary care without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 深部內膜異位與多專科

stages.title: 症狀
stages.evidence: 她說經痛到請假、排便時劇痛；前醫說「月經本來就會痛」。
stages.evidenceEn: She misses work with period pain and has severe pain opening her bowels; a previous doctor said periods hurt.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 同意前醫說法，屬正常經痛
choices.en: Agree with the last doctor: normal period pain

choices.zh: 符合內膜異位的核心症狀
choices.en: These are core symptoms of endometriosis

choices.zh: 轉介精神科評估身心症狀
choices.en: Refer to psychiatry for somatic symptoms

stages.reason: 診斷平均延遲七年以上；症狀被正常化是主因。
stages.reasonEn: Diagnosis is delayed on average by more than seven years, largely because symptoms are normalised.
stages.pitfall: 若正常化：再延遲數年。
stages.pitfallEn: Normalised again, years more delay.

stages.title: 檢查
stages.evidence: 內診：後穹窿結節、子宮後傾固定、觸痛。
stages.evidenceEn: Examination: posterior fornix nodules, a fixed retroverted uterus, tenderness.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 支持深部內膜異位
choices.en: Supports deep endometriosis

choices.zh: 檢查屬正常範圍
choices.en: Within normal examination limits

choices.zh: 骨盆腔感染所致觸痛
choices.en: Tenderness from pelvic infection

stages.reason: 固定後傾子宮與後穹窿結節是深部病灶的徵象；檢查正常也不排除。
stages.reasonEn: A fixed retroverted uterus and posterior nodules signal deep disease; a normal examination does not exclude it.
stages.pitfall: 若誤讀：病灶被當感染治療。
stages.pitfallEn: Misread, the nodules are treated as infection.

stages.title: 影像
stages.evidence: 經陰道超音波「正常」；住院醫師說排除了。
stages.evidenceEn: The transvaginal scan is normal; the resident says endometriosis is excluded.
stages.question: 此發現最合理的判讀是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable interpretation?

choices.zh: 超音波正常，已排除
choices.en: Normal scan, so excluded

choices.zh: 正常超音波不能排除
choices.en: A normal scan does not exclude it

choices.zh: 需安排電腦斷層確認
choices.en: A CT scan is needed to confirm

stages.reason: 表淺腹膜病灶影像看不到；影像的價值在囊腫與深部結節。
stages.reasonEn: Superficial peritoneal disease is invisible on imaging, whose value lies in endometriomas and deep nodules.
stages.pitfall: 若排除：治療被拒。
stages.pitfallEn: Excluded, treatment is denied.

stages.title: 經驗性治療
stages.evidence: 她問一定要開刀才能治療嗎。
stages.evidenceEn: She asks whether surgery is needed before treatment.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 必須先腹腔鏡確診才能治療
choices.en: Laparoscopy must confirm it before treatment

choices.zh: 臨床懷疑即可開始治療
choices.en: Treatment can start on clinical suspicion

choices.zh: 只能止痛，荷爾蒙無效
choices.en: Analgesia only; hormones do not help

stages.reason: 經驗性荷爾蒙治療是指引建議；手術確診不是治療的前提。
stages.reasonEn: Empirical hormonal treatment is guideline-endorsed; surgical diagnosis is not a precondition.
stages.pitfall: 若等手術：數月無治療。
stages.pitfallEn: Waiting for surgery means months untreated.

stages.title: 荷爾蒙原則
stages.evidence: 主治問荷爾蒙選項的原則。
stages.evidenceEn: The attending asks for the principles.
stages.question: 最適當的處置為？
stages.questionEn: What is the most appropriate management?

choices.zh: 避孕藥或黃體素為第一線
choices.en: The pill or a progestogen first line

choices.zh: 一律使用 GnRH 類似物
choices.en: Always use a GnRH analogue

choices.zh: 單方雌激素抑制病灶
choices.en: Oestrogen alone to suppress lesions

stages.reason: 荷爾蒙抑制月經與病灶活性；GnRH 的骨質與更年期副作用限制其順位。
stages.reasonEn: Hormones suppress menstruation and lesion activity; GnRH's bone and menopausal effects place it second.
stages.pitfall: 若直接 GnRH：不必要的副作用。
stages.pitfallEn: Straight to GnRH, needless side effects.

stages.title: 腹腔鏡
stages.evidence: 一線與二線荷爾蒙治療皆已無效。
stages.evidenceEn: First- and second-line hormones have both failed.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 再換一種荷爾蒙藥物試試
choices.en: Try another hormonal drug

choices.zh: 腹腔鏡診斷並同時處理
choices.en: Laparoscopy to diagnose and treat together

choices.zh: 直接做子宮切除根治
choices.en: Hysterectomy as a definitive cure

stages.reason: 手術的價值在於同時治療；只看不治的腹腔鏡應避免。
stages.reasonEn: The value of surgery is treatment at the same time; diagnostic-only laparoscopy should be avoided.
stages.pitfall: 若只看：她需要第二次手術。
stages.pitfallEn: Look only, and she needs a second operation.

stages.title: 深部病灶
stages.evidence: MRI：直腸陰道隔結節侵犯直腸肌層。
stages.evidenceEn: MRI: a rectovaginal nodule invading the rectal muscularis.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 一般婦科門診即可處理
choices.en: A general gynaecology clinic can manage it

choices.zh: 轉專科中心多專科規劃
choices.en: Refer to a specialist centre for team planning

choices.zh: 不需手術，荷爾蒙即可
choices.en: No surgery; hormones will do

stages.reason: 腸道與輸尿管的深部病灶需要跨科手術；專科中心結局較佳。
stages.reasonEn: Deep bowel and ureteric disease needs cross-specialty surgery; outcomes are better in specialist centres.
stages.pitfall: 若一般團隊手術：腸道損傷與不完全切除。
stages.pitfallEn: Operated by a general team, bowel injury and incomplete excision.

stages.title: 生育
stages.evidence: 她想半年內懷孕；問荷爾蒙與手術的影響。
stages.evidenceEn: She wants to conceive within six months and asks about hormones and surgery.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 荷爾蒙治療期間可提高受孕率
choices.en: Hormone treatment improves the chance of conception

choices.zh: 荷爾蒙抑制期間無法受孕
choices.en: Conception cannot happen during suppression

choices.zh: 一定要先切除卵巢囊腫再懷孕
choices.en: The endometrioma must be removed before trying

stages.reason: 子宮內膜異位瘤切除可能損耗卵巢儲備；生育計畫改變手術決策。
stages.reasonEn: Endometrioma surgery can deplete ovarian reserve; fertility plans change surgical decisions.
stages.pitfall: 若貿然切囊腫：卵巢儲備下降。
stages.pitfallEn: An unconsidered cystectomy lowers her ovarian reserve.

stages.title: 疼痛整合
stages.evidence: 手術後疼痛部分改善，但持續存在。
stages.evidenceEn: Pain improves partly after surgery but persists.
stages.question: 最合理的計畫是？
stages.questionEn: What is the most reasonable plan?

choices.zh: 再開一次刀，把病灶切乾淨
choices.en: Operate again to clear all the disease

choices.zh: 加入疼痛科與物理心理支持
choices.en: Add pain, physio and psychological support

choices.zh: 告訴她手術已成功，是她想太多
choices.en: Say the operation worked and she is imagining it

stages.reason: 慢性骨盆痛涉及中樞敏感化與骨盆底肌；單靠手術不足。
stages.reasonEn: Chronic pelvic pain involves central sensitisation and the pelvic floor; surgery alone is not enough.
stages.pitfall: 若反覆手術：沾黏與更多疼痛。
stages.pitfallEn: Repeated surgery breeds adhesions and more pain.

stages.title: 追蹤與交班
stages.evidence: 她將由專科護理師追蹤。
stages.evidenceEn: The nurse specialist takes over follow-up.
stages.question: 團隊此刻應如何處理？
stages.questionEn: How should the team handle this now?

choices.zh: 交班診斷、計畫與復發警訊
choices.en: Hand over diagnosis, plan and warning signs

choices.zh: 病情穩定，不需特別交班
choices.en: Stable, so no special handover

choices.zh: 症狀改善後出院，不需追蹤
choices.en: Discharge once better; no follow-up

stages.reason: 內膜異位是慢性疾病；長期計畫與單一聯絡窗口減少重複就診。
stages.reasonEn: Endometriosis is chronic; a long-term plan and a single point of contact reduce repeated presentations.
stages.pitfall: 若無交班：她回到急診循環。
stages.pitfallEn: Without it, she cycles back through the emergency department.

procedures.title: 骨盆腔感染與輸卵管卵巢膿瘍：低閾值治療、失敗辨識與引流
procedures.titleEn: Pelvic inflammatory disease and tubo-ovarian abscess: low threshold to treat, recognising failure and drainage
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：24 歲女性，下腹痛、發燒、新性伴侶，急診由婦科住院醫師、主治、放射科與感染科共同處理。本單元教診斷門檻、檢驗、治療失敗的辨識與引流時機，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 24-year-old with lower abdominal pain, fever and a new partner, managed in the emergency department by the gynaecology resident, attending, radiologist and infectious diseases. Teaches the diagnostic threshold, tests, recognising treatment failure and timing of drainage without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 卵巢扭轉急症：臨床懷疑、多普勒的陷阱與保留卵巢的手術
procedures.titleEn: Ovarian torsion: clinical suspicion, the Doppler trap and ovary-sparing surgery
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：19 歲女性，突發右下腹劇痛伴嘔吐，急診由婦科住院醫師、主治、超音波師與麻醉科共同處理。本單元教辨識、影像判讀的陷阱、手術時機與保留卵巢的原則，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 19-year-old with sudden severe right lower abdominal pain and vomiting, managed by the gynaecology resident, attending, sonographer and anaesthetist. Teaches recognition, imaging pitfalls, timing of surgery and ovarian conservation; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 子宮外孕：破裂的急症處置、腹腔鏡手術選擇與甲氨蝶呤原則
procedures.titleEn: Ectopic pregnancy: the ruptured emergency, laparoscopic choices and methotrexate principles
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：31 歲女性，停經七週、腹痛暈厥，急診血壓低；同日早期妊娠門診另一位穩定的疑似子宮外孕病人。婦科住院醫師、主治、麻醉科、血庫與早期妊娠護理師共同處理。本單元教辨識、復甦、手術選擇與藥物治療的適用原則，不含劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 31-year-old, seven weeks amenorrhoea, pain and syncope with hypotension; the same day a stable suspected ectopic attends the early pregnancy unit. The resident, attending, anaesthetist, blood bank and early pregnancy nurse manage both. Teaches recognition, resuscitation, surgical choices and the principles of medical treatment without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 穩定病人：超音波與 hCG

procedures.title: 早期流產：超音波診斷、期待、藥物與手術處置的選擇
procedures.titleEn: Early miscarriage: ultrasound diagnosis and expectant, medical and surgical management
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：27 歲女性，停經九週，少量出血，早期妊娠門診由護理師、超音波師、婦科住院醫師與主治共同照護。本單元教診斷標準的邏輯、告知、選項諮詢與併發症辨識，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 27-year-old at nine weeks with light bleeding in the early pregnancy unit, cared for by the nurse, sonographer, resident and attending. Teaches the logic of diagnostic criteria, breaking the news, counselling on options and complication recognition without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 巴氏腺膿瘍：診斷、Word 導管或造袋術與追蹤
procedures.titleEn: Bartholin abscess: diagnosis, Word catheter or marsupialisation and follow-up
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：32 歲女性，右側外陰腫痛三天無法坐下，急診由婦科住院醫師、主治與護理師處理。本單元教診斷、鑑別、程序選擇與安全，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 32-year-old with three days of painful right vulval swelling and unable to sit, seen by the gynaecology resident, attending and nurse. Teaches diagnosis, differentials, procedure choice and safety without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 避孕諮詢與長效可逆避孕的置入安全：UKMEC、子宮內裝置與植入劑
procedures.titleEn: Contraception counselling and safe LARC insertion: UKMEC, intrauterine devices and the implant
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：24 歲女性，要求可靠避孕，有先兆偏頭痛；門診由婦科住院醫師、主治與避孕護理師共同處理。本單元教醫療適用標準、諮詢、置入安全與併發症，不含藥物劑量，屬教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: 24-year-old wanting reliable contraception, with migraine with aura, seen by the resident, attending and contraception nurse. Teaches medical eligibility criteria, counselling, insertion safety and complications without doses; an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 子宮頸癌篩檢：HPV 初篩、細胞學分流與 Bethesda 判讀
procedures.titleEn: Cervical screening: primary HPV testing, cytology triage and the Bethesda system
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：34 歲女性，例行子宮頸篩檢；她的朋友說「HPV 陽性就是快得癌症」。門診由婦科住院醫師、主治、細胞病理師與篩檢個管師共同處理，從取樣品質、HPV 結果的意義、Bethesda 分類到轉介與失聯追蹤。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 34-year-old attends for routine cervical screening; a friend has told her a positive HPV test means cancer is coming. The gynaecology resident, attending, cytopathologist and screening coordinator work through sample quality, what an HPV result means, the Bethesda categories, referral and failsafe tracking. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 陰道鏡與 LLETZ：轉化區判讀、見即治與治癒追蹤
procedures.titleEn: Colposcopy and LLETZ: reading the transformation zone, see-and-treat and test of cure
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：29 歲女性，HPV 陽性、細胞學 HSIL，轉陰道鏡門診；她計畫明年懷孕，非常害怕疼痛。陰道鏡主治、住院醫師、陰道鏡護理師與病理科共同處理。本單元教陰道鏡判讀的邏輯、治療的選擇與同意、電環切除的團隊安全、病理判讀與治癒追蹤，不含能量設定與操作步驟。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 29-year-old with HPV-positive HSIL cytology is referred to colposcopy; she plans a pregnancy next year and is frightened of pain. The colposcopist, resident, colposcopy nurse and pathologist manage her. Teaches the logic of colposcopic assessment, treatment choice and consent, team safety for loop excision, pathology and test of cure, without energy settings or operative steps. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 子宮鏡手術：灌流液差額安全、氣體栓塞與子宮穿孔的辨識
procedures.titleEn: Hysteroscopic surgery: fluid deficit safety, gas embolism and recognising uterine perforation
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：47 歲女性，月經過多與多發子宮內膜息肉，先在門診子宮鏡評估，後排入手術室接受子宮鏡切除；她有心衰竭病史。婦科主治、住院醫師、麻醉科、刷手與流動護理師共同處理。本單元教門診子宮鏡的耐受、膨宮介質的選擇、灌流液差額的分工、低血鈉、穿孔與氣體栓塞的辨識，不含能量設定、壓力設定與操作步驟。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 47-year-old with heavy bleeding and multiple endometrial polyps is assessed by outpatient hysteroscopy and then listed for operative resection; she has heart failure. The attending, resident, anaesthetist and scrub and circulating nurses manage her. Teaches outpatient tolerance, choice of distension medium, team roles for the fluid deficit, and recognising hyponatraemia, perforation and gas embolism, without energy or pressure settings or operative steps. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 診斷與手術性腹腔鏡：進入安全、血管與腸道損傷的辨識
procedures.titleEn: Diagnostic and operative laparoscopy: safe entry and recognising vascular and bowel injury
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：34 歲女性，BMI 36，曾因闌尾破裂接受正中開腹；試管嬰兒前發現雙側輸卵管積水，排定腹腔鏡輸卵管切除。婦科主治、住院醫師、麻醉科、刷手與流動護理師、一般外科共同處理。本單元教術前風險、進入方式的選擇、進入後的檢查、血管與腸道損傷的辨識與團隊反應、延遲性損傷的警訊，不含能量設定、氣腹壓力與操作步驟。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 34-year-old with a BMI of 36 and a previous midline laparotomy for a perforated appendix has bilateral hydrosalpinges before IVF and is listed for laparoscopic salpingectomy. The attending, resident, anaesthetist, scrub and circulating nurses and general surgeons are involved. Teaches preoperative risk, choice of entry, inspection after entry, recognising vascular and bowel injury and the team response, and warning signs of delayed injury, without energy or insufflation settings or operative steps. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 全腹腔鏡與開腹子宮切除：路徑選擇、輸尿管與膀胱安全
procedures.titleEn: Total laparoscopic and abdominal hysterectomy: choosing the route and protecting the ureter and bladder
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：46 歲女性，多發子宮肌瘤與月經過多，藥物治療無效、已完成生育，選擇子宮切除；她曾兩次剖腹產，MRI 見子宮頸肌瘤往左骨盆壁擴張。婦科主治、住院醫師、麻醉科、刷手與流動護理師、泌尿科共同處理。本單元教路徑選擇、術前優化、輸尿管與膀胱的辨識原則、術中損傷的辨識與即時處理、術後警訊與交班，不含能量設定與操作步驟。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 46-year-old with multiple fibroids and heavy bleeding, failed medical treatment and a completed family, chooses hysterectomy; she has had two caesareans and MRI shows a cervical fibroid extending towards the left pelvic sidewall. The attending, resident, anaesthetist, scrub and circulating nurses and urologists are involved. Teaches route selection, optimisation, principles of identifying the ureter and bladder, recognising and managing intraoperative injury, and postoperative warning signs and handover, without energy settings or operative steps. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 骨盆器官脫垂：POP-Q 評估、子宮托、陰道式子宮切除與修補
procedures.titleEn: Pelvic organ prolapse: POP-Q assessment, pessaries, vaginal hysterectomy and repair
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：68 歲女性，三次陰道產，陰道口有東西掉出、排尿要用手推回；她是失智丈夫的主要照顧者。婦科主治、住院醫師、骨盆底物理治療師、門診護理師與麻醉科共同處理。本單元教症狀與 POP-Q 評估、保守與手術選項、網片的告知、陰道式手術的安全與術後排尿，不含操作步驟。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 68-year-old with three vaginal births has a bulge at the introitus and has to push it back to void; she is the main carer for her husband with dementia. The attending, resident, pelvic floor physiotherapist, clinic nurse and anaesthetist are involved. Teaches symptom and POP-Q assessment, conservative and surgical options, mesh disclosure, safety in vaginal surgery and postoperative voiding, without operative steps. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 女性尿失禁門診：壓力性與急迫性、尿動力學的時機與網片告知
procedures.titleEn: The female urinary incontinence clinic: stress versus urge, when to do urodynamics and mesh disclosure
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：52 歲女性，咳嗽與跑步時漏尿五年，近一年又常「來不及上廁所」，已不敢參加合唱團。泌尿婦科主治、住院醫師、骨盆底物理治療師、尿失禁專科護理師與多專科會議共同處理。本單元教分型、紅旗、排尿日誌、保守治療、藥物的抗膽鹼負荷、尿動力學的適應症、手術選項與網片的知情同意，不含藥物劑量。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 52-year-old has leaked on coughing and running for five years and for the past year often cannot reach the toilet in time; she has stopped singing in her choir. The urogynaecologist, resident, pelvic floor physiotherapist, continence nurse and MDT are involved. Teaches typing, red flags, bladder diaries, conservative care, anticholinergic burden, indications for urodynamics, surgical options and informed consent for mesh, without doses. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 婦科術後照護與加速康復：從術前衛教到出院標準
procedures.titleEn: Postoperative care and enhanced recovery in gynaecology: from preoperative education to discharge criteria
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：55 歲女性，因第一期子宮內膜癌接受腹腔鏡子宮與雙側附件切除後回到婦科病房；她有第二型糖尿病、睡眠呼吸中止與術後噁心病史。病房護理師、婦科住院醫師、主治、麻醉科急性疼痛小組、物理治療師與營養師共同照護。本單元教加速康復各元素的理由、早期警示分數、多模式止痛與噁心處理、導尿管與活動、血栓預防與出院標準，不含藥物劑量。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 55-year-old returns to the gynaecology ward after laparoscopic hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy for stage I endometrial cancer; she has type 2 diabetes, sleep apnoea and previous postoperative nausea. Ward nurses, the resident, attending, acute pain team, physiotherapist and dietitian care for her. Teaches the reasons behind enhanced recovery elements, early warning scores, multimodal analgesia and nausea, catheters and mobilisation, thromboprophylaxis and discharge criteria, without doses. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 病房上的術後併發症：出血、腸阻塞、輸尿管損傷與靜脈血栓
procedures.titleEn: Postoperative complications on the ward: bleeding, ileus, ureteric injury and venous thromboembolism
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：夜班婦科住院醫師同時接到四通電話：開腹肌瘤切除後第 0 天心跳變快、子宮切除後第 3 天腹脹嘔吐、腹腔鏡子宮切除後第 9 天陰道持續流水、以及術後第 5 天突然喘。婦科主治、病房護理師、放射科、泌尿科、一般外科與快速反應小組共同處理。本單元教分流、辨識、升級、Clavien-Dindo 分級與坦誠溝通，不含藥物劑量。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: the night gynaecology resident takes four calls at once: day 0 after open myomectomy with a rising heart rate, day 3 after hysterectomy with distension and vomiting, day 9 after laparoscopic hysterectomy with constant vaginal fluid, and sudden breathlessness on day 5. The attending, ward nurses, radiology, urology, general surgery and the rapid response team are involved. Teaches triage, recognition, escalation, Clavien-Dindo grading and candid communication, without doses. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 婦科交班與多專科會議：SBAR、急診手術排序與腫瘤 MDT 的準備
procedures.titleEn: Gynaecology handover and the MDT: SBAR, prioritising emergency theatre and preparing for the tumour board
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：週五晚上八點婦科交班，白班住院醫師要把九位住院病人、急診兩位待評估病人與一張急診手術名單交給夜班；週一還要在婦癌多專科會議報告兩位新病人。婦科主治、住院醫師、病房護理長、麻醉科、腫瘤個管師、病理科與放射科共同參與。本單元教結構化交班、風險優先、急診手術分級、升級文化、MDT 的資料準備與決策紀錄。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: Friday 8 pm gynaecology handover; the day resident must hand nine inpatients, two emergency referrals and an emergency theatre list to the night team, and on Monday present two new patients at the gynaecological oncology MDT. The attending, residents, nurse in charge, anaesthetist, cancer nurse specialist, pathologist and radiologist take part. Teaches structured handover, sickest-first prioritisation, emergency theatre categories, escalation culture, MDT preparation and documenting decisions. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 停經後出血與子宮內膜癌路徑：快速轉診、內膜厚度、取樣與分子分類
procedures.titleEn: Postmenopausal bleeding and the endometrial cancer pathway: fast-track referral, endometrial thickness, sampling and molecular classification
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：61 歲女性，停經九年，兩週前少量出血一次「以為沒事」；BMI 38、第二型糖尿病、未生育。家醫、婦科住院醫師、主治、超音波師、病理科、腫瘤個管師與多專科會議共同處理。本單元教快速轉診、超音波的判讀與限制、取樣與子宮鏡、病理與分子分類的意義、分期影像與治療原則，不含藥物劑量。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 61-year-old, nine years past menopause, had a single light bleed two weeks ago that she assumed was nothing; BMI 38, type 2 diabetes, nulliparous. Her family doctor, the gynaecology resident, attending, sonographer, pathologist, cancer nurse specialist and MDT are involved. Teaches fast-track referral, interpreting ultrasound and its limits, sampling and hysteroscopy, what pathology and molecular classification mean, staging imaging and treatment principles, without doses. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

stations.zh: 分子分類與林奇症候群

procedures.title: 附件腫塊：RMI、IOTA 簡易規則、多專科會議與術中冰凍切片
procedures.titleEn: The adnexal mass: RMI, IOTA simple rules, the MDT and intraoperative frozen section
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：58 歲停經女性，腹脹三個月、吃一點就飽，超音波見 9 公分含實質部分的多房腫塊；同日門診另有一位 27 歲、偶然發現 6 公分卵巢囊腫且希望保留生育的女性。婦科主治、住院醫師、超音波專家、放射科、婦癌外科、病理科與腫瘤個管師共同處理。本單元教症狀辨識、IOTA 規則與 RMI 計算、轉介婦癌中心、完整取出的原則與冰凍切片的意義及限制，不含操作步驟。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 58-year-old postmenopausal woman has three months of bloating and early satiety, and ultrasound shows a 9 cm multilocular mass with solid areas; in the same clinic a 27-year-old wishing to preserve fertility has an incidental 6 cm ovarian cyst. The attending, resident, expert sonographer, radiologist, gynaecological oncologist, pathologist and cancer nurse specialist are involved. Teaches symptom recognition, IOTA rules and RMI calculation, referral to a cancer centre, principles of intact removal and the meaning and limits of frozen section, without operative steps. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 子宮頸癌：FIGO 2018 分期、影像與治療選擇
procedures.titleEn: Cervical cancer: FIGO 2018 staging, imaging and treatment choices
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：39 歲女性，性交後出血半年，八年沒做抹片；鴨嘴檢查見子宮頸 3 公分外生性腫塊。婦癌主治、住院醫師、放射科、病理科、放射腫瘤科、腫瘤個管師與心理師共同處理。本單元教可見病灶的處理、FIGO 2018 分期的邏輯、影像的角色、手術與同步放化療的選擇原則、保留生育與卵巢的考量與存活照護，不含藥物與放射劑量。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 39-year-old has had postcoital bleeding for six months and no smear for eight years; speculum examination shows a 3 cm exophytic cervical mass. The gynaecological oncologist, resident, radiologist, pathologist, clinical oncologist, cancer nurse specialist and psychologist are involved. Teaches handling a visible lesion, the logic of FIGO 2018 staging, the role of imaging, principles of choosing surgery or chemoradiation, fertility and ovarian preservation, and survivorship, without drug or radiation doses. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 外陰病變：硬化性苔蘚、外陰上皮內病變與外陰切片
procedures.titleEn: Vulval disease: lichen sclerosus, vulval intraepithelial neoplasia and vulval biopsy
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：64 歲女性外陰癢多年，自行使用多種藥膏並每天用抗菌洗劑清洗；近三個月左側小陰唇一處硬塊不癒合。婦科住院醫師、主治、外陰門診護理師、皮膚科與病理科共同處理。本單元教外陰病史與檢查、硬化性苔蘚的辨識與長期照護、VIN 的分類、外陰切片的適應症與安全、快速轉診，不含藥物劑量與操作步驟。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 64-year-old has had vulval itch for years, using several creams and washing daily with antiseptic; for three months a lump on the left labium minus has not healed. The gynaecology resident, attending, vulval clinic nurse, dermatologist and pathologist are involved. Teaches vulval history and examination, recognising and managing lichen sclerosus long-term, VIN classification, indications for and safety of vulval biopsy, and fast-track referral, without doses or operative steps. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 更年期與荷爾蒙治療諮詢：診斷、利弊溝通與個人化選擇
procedures.titleEn: Menopause and HRT counselling: diagnosis, communicating benefit and risk, and individual choice
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：51 歲女性，月經不規則一年，熱潮紅與夜汗影響睡眠與工作，情緒低落、性交疼痛；母親 68 歲時罹患乳癌。家醫、婦科住院醫師、主治、更年期門診護理師與心理師共同處理。本單元教更年期的臨床診斷、早發性卵巢功能不全、以絕對風險溝通荷爾蒙治療的利弊、黃體素的內膜保護、給藥途徑、局部雌激素、非荷爾蒙選項與追蹤，不含藥物劑量。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 51-year-old with a year of irregular periods has hot flushes and night sweats disrupting sleep and work, low mood and painful sex; her mother had breast cancer at 68. Her family doctor, the resident, attending, menopause nurse and psychologist are involved. Teaches clinical diagnosis of menopause, premature ovarian insufficiency, communicating HRT benefit and risk in absolute terms, endometrial protection with progestogen, route of administration, vaginal oestrogen, non-hormonal options and review, without doses. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 多囊性卵巢症候群門診：鹿特丹標準、排除診斷與長期健康
procedures.titleEn: The PCOS clinic: Rotterdam criteria, excluding mimics and long-term health
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：23 歲女性，月經兩到四個月一次、痤瘡與下巴多毛，曾被說「胖就會這樣，減肥就好」；最近情緒低落、暴食後自責。婦科住院醫師、主治、內分泌科、營養師與心理師共同處理。本單元教鹿特丹標準的正確使用、需排除的疾病、青少年的特殊性、代謝與心理篩檢、內膜保護與治療目標，不含藥物劑量。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 23-year-old has periods every two to four months, acne and chin hair, and has been told it is all because she is overweight; lately she feels low and binge eats, then blames herself. The resident, attending, endocrinologist, dietitian and psychologist are involved. Teaches correct use of the Rotterdam criteria, conditions to exclude, the special case of adolescents, metabolic and mental health screening, endometrial protection and treatment goals, without doses. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 不孕症的伴侶評估：排卵、卵巢庫存、輸卵管通暢與 WHO 精液分析
procedures.titleEn: The infertility workup for the couple: ovulation, ovarian reserve, tubal patency and WHO semen analysis
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：36 歲女性與 38 歲伴侶，規律無避孕性生活十個月未懷孕；她月經週期 35 天、曾因披衣菌骨盆腔感染住院；伴侶「覺得自己沒問題」不想來，並在健身房使用睪固酮。生殖醫學主治、婦科住院醫師、生殖中心護理師、胚胎實驗室與泌尿科共同處理。本單元教轉診時機、雙方病史、排卵與卵巢庫存的判讀、輸卵管檢查的選擇、WHO 精液分析的術語與重驗時機、不明原因不孕，不含藥物劑量。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 36-year-old and her 38-year-old partner have had regular unprotected intercourse for ten months without conceiving; her cycles are 35 days and she was once admitted with chlamydial pelvic infection; her partner thinks he is fine, does not want to attend, and uses testosterone from his gym. The fertility specialist, resident, fertility nurse, embryology laboratory and urologist are involved. Teaches when to refer, history from both partners, interpreting ovulation and ovarian reserve tests, choosing a tubal test, WHO semen terminology and when to repeat, and unexplained infertility, without doses. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 排卵誘導：WHO 無排卵分組、監測、多胎與 OHSS 的早期辨識
procedures.titleEn: Ovulation induction: WHO anovulation groups, monitoring, multiple pregnancy and early recognition of OHSS
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：29 歲 PCOS 女性，letrozole 三個週期未排卵，準備改用促性腺激素；同一門診另有一位因過度訓練而停經的 26 歲長跑選手。生殖醫學主治、住院醫師、生殖中心護理師與超音波師共同處理。本單元教無排卵的分類與對應、口服與注射藥物的原則與監測、取消週期的決定、多胎風險，以及 OHSS 的早期辨識與電話分流，不含藥物劑量。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 29-year-old with PCOS has not ovulated on three cycles of letrozole and is moving to gonadotrophins; in the same clinic is a 26-year-old distance runner with amenorrhoea from overtraining. The fertility specialist, resident, fertility nurse and sonographer are involved. Teaches classifying anovulation and matching treatment, principles and monitoring of oral and injectable agents, the decision to cancel a cycle, multiple pregnancy risk, and early recognition and telephone triage of OHSS, without doses. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 試管嬰兒週期與嚴重卵巢過度刺激症候群急症
procedures.titleEn: The IVF cycle and the severe OHSS emergency
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：31 歲 PCOS 女性，試管嬰兒取卵 24 顆後第 5 天到急診：腹脹如鼓、喘、尿少、嘔吐。生殖醫學主治、婦科住院醫師、急診醫師、麻醉與加護、病房護理師與超音波師共同處理。本單元先回顧週期中預防 OHSS 的決策點，再練習嚴重 OHSS 的分級、住院照護、血栓與腹水處理及升級加護的時機，不含藥物劑量與輸液速率。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 31-year-old with PCOS presents to the emergency department five days after an IVF egg collection yielding 24 oocytes, with a tense abdomen, breathlessness, low urine output and vomiting. The fertility specialist, gynaecology resident, emergency physician, anaesthesia and critical care, ward nurses and sonographer are involved. Teaches the decision points for preventing OHSS during the cycle, then grading severe OHSS, inpatient care, thrombosis and ascites management and when to escalate to critical care, without doses or infusion rates. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 葡萄胎與妊娠滋養層疾病：早期妊娠門診的辨識、吸引清除與 hCG 追蹤
procedures.titleEn: Molar pregnancy and gestational trophoblastic disease: recognition in the early pregnancy unit, suction evacuation and hCG surveillance
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：33 歲女性，停經 10 週，陰道出血與嚴重孕吐，子宮大於週數；早期妊娠門診超音波可疑。早期妊娠門診護理師、超音波師、婦科住院醫師、主治、麻醉科、病理科與滋養層疾病中心共同處理。本單元教辨識、全身影響、吸引清除的安全原則、病理與登記追蹤、避孕與下次懷孕、持續性滋養層腫瘤的警訊與 FIGO 預後評分的概念，不含藥物劑量與操作步驟。本單元為教學情境，不是臨床規範。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual case: a 33-year-old at ten weeks' amenorrhoea has vaginal bleeding, severe vomiting and a uterus large for dates; the early pregnancy unit scan is suspicious. The early pregnancy nurse, sonographer, gynaecology resident, attending, anaesthetist, pathologist and trophoblastic disease centre are involved. Teaches recognition, systemic effects, safety principles of suction evacuation, histology and registration for surveillance, contraception and the next pregnancy, warning signs of persistent trophoblastic neoplasia and the concept of the FIGO prognostic score, without doses or operative steps. This is an educational scenario, not a clinical protocol.
